headlines.title: Jordan strikes Syria after church attack, killing at least seven people
headlines.summary: Syria closes border crossings with Jordan after air strikes kill seven people in Deraa and Suweyda, including children.

headlines.title: Bolsonaro’s party accepts Brazil election after Trump calls vote ‘rigged’
headlines.summary: Trump pushes unsubstantiated claims about Brazil's presidential vote but says he 'didn't take sides' in the race.

headlines.title: UN panel accuses Israel of ‘extermination’ in West Bank, genocide in Gaza
headlines.summary: Report finds extermination, torture and rape in the West Bank and says genocide in Gaza is continuing despite ceasefire.

headlines.title: Harry Kane becomes first Englishman in 25 years to win Ballon d'Or
headlines.summary: Kane was followed in the voting by Kylian Mbappé. Spain star Alexia Putellas won her third women's Ballon d'Or. Outside, fans packed the streets and climbed light poles near the London Palladium.

headlines.title: Jay-Z picks himself to headline the Super Bowl halftime show in Southern California
headlines.summary: The NFL, Apple Music and Roc Nation announced Monday night that Jay-Z will be the featured performer for the halftime festivities on Feb. 14 at SoFi Stadium in Inglewood, California.

headlines.title: Brewers rout the Rays 10-1 to move within a win of their first World Series title
headlines.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers are one victory from their first World Series title after routing the Tampa Bay Rays 10-1 on Monday night thanks to a trio of young players who have shined in October.

headlines.title: Local ceasefire brokered by Melania Trump starts in southern Ukraine
headlines.summary: A localized ceasefire between Ukraine and Russia took effect early Tuesday ahead of a humanitarian mission brokered by U.S. first lady Melania Trump, as missile attacks resumed in Kyiv.

headlines.title: Trump campaigns in Mississippi, highlighting Republicans' challenges
headlines.summary: President Trump campaigned Monday in Mississippi, as he continued a closing midterm rally blitz that has highlighted Republicans' challenges ahead of an election that could drastically shift power in Washington.

headlines.title: Zero tariffs boost South Africa's exports
headlines.summary: South African officials have welcomed the increase in trade with China following the operationalization of China's zero-tariff treatment of the country.

headlines.title: Serbia's Vucic concedes defeat in polls
headlines.summary: Former Serbian president Aleksandar Vucic conceded defeat in Sunday's snap parliamentary election, as independent projections and leaders of a student-backed movement born out of anti-corruption protests confirmed an outright parliamentary majority that ends the ruling party's 14-year grip on power.

headlines.title: UK's Burnham open to EU free movement
headlines.summary: United Kingdom Prime Minister Andy Burnham has signaled openness to discussing a return to free movement between the UK and the European Union, which was a key issue in the 2016 Brexit referendum that led to the UK leaving the bloc.

headlines.title: Europe on high alert after weekend riots
headlines.summary: Law enforcement agencies across Europe are braced for more trouble after cost-of-living protests turned violent again on the weekend, leading to more than 1,300 arrests in France, mass unrest in Spain, and turmoil in many other countries.

headlines.title: Iran holds ground as war fears mount
headlines.summary: As fears mount of a full-scale regional war ahead of pivotal elections in Israel and the United States, Iran has said it is prepared for "any scenario" while keeping diplomatic channels open.

headlines.title: Rape and murder accused killed in encounter in West Bengal’s Bongaon
headlines.summary: Second such encounter in West Bengal: 23-year-old rape-and-murder prime accused shot dead in Bongaon after police confrontation.
